(A) 2pm to 3pm

(C) 5am to 10am
(D) 3pm to 4pm

- **Between 10am to 2pm:** Samantha saw Jennifer, so she cannot have gone to the park during this time.
- **Between 2pm to 3pm:** William saw Jennifer, so she cannot have gone to the park during this time.
- **Between 4pm to 5pm:** Ashley saw Jennifer, so she cannot have gone to the park during this time.
- **Between 5pm to 8pm:** Andrew saw Jennifer, so she cannot have gone to the park during this time.

The only period left is **between 5am to 10am**. Therefore, Jennifer could have gone to the amusement park between 5am to 10am.
